title: Songs of Innocence and Experience - Echoing Green, The (Innocence)
summary: Songs of Innocence and Experience by . William Blake’s volume of poetry entitled Songs of Innocence and Experience is the embodiment of his belief that innocence and experience were “the two contrary states of the human soul,” and that true innocence was impossible without experience.
